comparison.objective: Tear the front panel from a shelf-ready tray while leaving every can upright.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled tearing along a perforation while stabilizing a loaded carton.
comparison.success_condition: All ties torn on-line, panel removed, tray nearly unmoved, 12 cans upright, hands clear, stable 1 s; off-line tearing or excess tray tilt fails.
comparison.reason: Perforation tearing with load preservation is different from aperture screening and media recovery. No material rubric detail is missing.
